description: This file contains test cases for the models configuration file mode behavior in the openclaw agent project, using the Vitest testing framework. It tests that the models.json file is written with correct permissions and that permission repairs are performed when necessary.

methods.name: installModelsConfigTestHooks
methods.description: Sets up test hooks related to models configuration.

methods.name: afterEach
methods.description: Registers a callback to be run after each test to reset cache.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite for models-config file mode.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines individual test cases for file permission behavior.

methods.name: ensureOpenClawModelsJson
methods.description: Ensures that the models.json file exists with correct contents and permissions.

methods.name: resetModelsJsonReadyCacheForTest
methods.description: Resets the cache related to models.json to ensure clean state for tests.

methods.description: Executes a function within a temporary home directory context.
